coverage.target: Lambda, CloudFront, S3, DynamoDB on-demand, SSM standard, CloudWatch Logs (infrastructure-specification.md Infrastructure Services)
No API Gateway / Secrets Manager; Lambda function URLs behind CloudFront
CloudWatch log groups per Lambda, 30-day retention
DynamoDB TTL on ProcessedLineEvents (7d) and RequestRecords (24h)
Lambda reserved concurrency 5 per function (quota check before B1)
AWS Budgets USD 1 monthly in Housework-Account stack
CloudWatch log groups 30-day retention
Serverless only: Lambda + CloudFront + S3 + DynamoDB, no VPC/EC2/ECS
CloudFront response headers policy (CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
CloudFront origin custom header X-Origin-Verify to both function URLs; direct call returns 403 (post-deploy check)
SSM Parameter Store SecureString under /housework-calendar/<env>/
gitleaks step in ci.yml
Per-Lambda IAM roles scoped to own env tables and parameter paths
GitHub OIDC roles (staging: main ref; production: environment production)
ci.yml without id-token permission or secrets for fork PRs
Housework-<env>-Data stack, DynamoDB RemovalPolicy RETAIN in production
Lambda timeout 30 seconds
ci.yml required by branch protection (Prettier, ESLint, tsc, Vitest coverage, gitleaks, cdk synth)
Separate staging/production stacks and parameter paths in one account
deploy-staging.yml on main push; deploy-production.yml workflow_dispatch with environment approval
